content: Interactive learning mechanics for 10-12 health/kids education: proven formats = short self-check quizzes (klicksafe Quiz Digitale Abhängigkeit, Internet-ABC Surfschein + in-module Quiz/Umfrage), scenario/dilemma discussions (Common Sense, eSafety ethical-dilemma activity), story-embedded challenges (Max & Min@ prevention program wraps exercises in a story about twins wanting a smartphone; freii 21-day program uses 4 peer-like guides + daily videos + offline challenges + points), explanations via short videos/Erklärfilme (Handysektor, NDR so geht MEDIEN), printables/worksheet (KidsHealth teacher guides + handouts), pacts/contracts (Mediennutzungsvertrag), certificates/awards (Surfschein, eSafety certificates, Medienführerschein Urkunden). Best practice: experiential + reflection, immediate feedback, peer-like voice, offline-action tasks; avoid pure didactic knowledge-dump (research: knowledge alone doesn't change behavior).
